5. I want to maximize my chances of getting a school I truly prefer

- Put y first (my most preferred) despite high competition
- Put x second (top priority, moderate preference)
- Put z third (top priority, moderate preference)
- Put w last (least preferred)

This strategy gives me the best chance of landing in a school I like, leveraging my priority ranks at x and z if y becomes competitive.
